pa-county-officials.summary: The County card names the county you picked, and not its commissioners, council, executive or other elected officers. The card says so rather than leave the office looking empty.
pa-county-officials.why: No statewide list of Pennsylvania's county officials has been read for this app yet, and the counties' own pages have not been read one by one.
pa-county-officials.wanted: One statewide list of each county's commissioners or council and its other elected officers, or a county's own published list of them.

pa-municipal-officeholders.summary: The City, Borough or Township card names the place you picked and what kind of municipality it is, and not its mayor, council, commissioners or supervisors.
pa-municipal-officeholders.why: Pennsylvania has more than two thousand municipalities, and no statewide list of their elected officials has been read for this app.
pa-municipal-officeholders.wanted: One statewide list of each municipality's elected officials, or a city's, borough's or township's own published list of them.

pa-school-board-members.summary: The School District card names the district you picked, and not the members of its school board.
pa-school-board-members.why: No statewide list of Pennsylvania's school board members has been read for this app, and the districts' own pages have not been read one by one.
pa-school-board-members.wanted: One statewide list of each school district's board members, or a district's own published list of its board.
